# Isaiah Chapter 45 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 25 verses]*

*Cyrus anointed; God forms light and darkness; potter and clay; every knee shall bow*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 45 (Cyrus, God's Anointed) addresses cyrus anointed; god forms light and darkness; potter and clay; every knee shall bow. The key verse — "Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
